During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Lohn Genden]] maintained a '''base''' of operations on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Gormdin]] in the [[Sarrelon system/Legends|Sarrelon system]]. It was a network of underground caves beneath a plateau, with ample space for Genden's mercenary band of fifty and their attendant [[Starship/Legends|starships]].
